philosophy: Recruitment proposals are text-only intent receipts; the browser drafts, stewards decide, and terminal tools ingest.

fields.name: note
fields.purpose: Statement of intent or contribution summary

fields.name: target_area
fields.purpose: Which Lodge surface the proposal concerns

ai_consumption_rules: Treat this as a text-only receipt format, not an execution surface.
Keep browser drafting read-only and reversible.
Route final review through steward-reviewed terminal tooling.
Do not invent wallet, swap, or payment behavior.
Do not add a browser write path or public proposal ingestion endpoint.
Prefer explicit, manual approval before any future branch mutates Firestore or chain state.
reserved_surfaces: x402 / Solana Pay / Blink payment rails
handoff_order: add a written contract before any payment or write branch
